fusions.name: Split Tine
fusions.desc: Flicks a two-pronged barb that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that. You heal for 10% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Branching Rot
fusions.desc: A strike with your weapon that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Glanced Both Ways
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage that reaches your shell is turned back on whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: The Other Road
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
